cn.description:
学生、教师、作家、医生、记者、学者和商务人士每天使用 Nautilus 来记录课堂笔记、会议记录、带批注的 PDF、已签署的文档、论文和讲座内容。

Notes Writer Pro 现已成为 Nautilus，基于全新的 Notes Writer App 打造。它保留熟悉的写作和 PDF 工具，并新增智能网页浏览器、用于阅读和研究的 AI 助手，以及魔法套索。数学笔记本可帮助你完成计算并创建图表，让你在 iPad 和 iPhone 上集中完成所有工作。

写作，打造专属内容
使用标题、列表、颜色和高亮创建笔记、论文和书籍。添加图片，或用 Apple Pencil 记笔记。使用听写功能，回听自己写下的内容，查看词数，并在标签页中保持文档打开。使用 MS Word、RTF、Markdown 和纯文本文件。

阅读并标注 PDF
阅读电子书、文章和课堂资料，然后在页边书写、高亮、绘图，并添加笔记、录音或签名。填写和签署表单，重新排列页面，将纸质文档扫描为 PDF。并排比较两份文档。按比例测量图纸，并在分享前隐藏敏感文字。

浏览和研究
使用内置浏览器阅读和研究，无需离开 Nautilus。在标签页中打开页面并为网站添加书签。向 AI 询问网页内容，让 AI 总结或翻译网页，或将网页转换为笔记。

使用魔法套索和 AI
用魔法套索圈选一段文字或其他内容，然后让 AI 解释或总结所选内容。还可获得写作帮助：改写、简化、纠正拼写和语法、调整语气，或通过对话梳理想法。

记录想法，之后再找
录下讲座、会议和想法。回听录音，或创建转录稿，以便日后查找重要细节。在白板上连接笔记、图片和录音，用便笺收集零散想法，并在大纲中整理计划。将研究资料汇总到学习项目中。使用分区和可视化的软木板规划书籍或长篇论文。将资料来源放在草稿旁边，修改时保存快照，然后编译成完整文档或电子书。

完成计算
使用数学笔记本将计算和说明放在一起。探索公式、创建图表，并预览完成后的 PDF。

整理与分享
将笔记保存在文件夹和笔记本中。为笔记本添加封面，方便识别。扫描纸质文档，导入 MS Word 文档和其他文件，并通过搜索找到所需内容。导出为 PDF、Word、HTML、EPUB 等格式。与 iCloud、Dropbox、Box、Google Drive 或 WebDAV 同步。

保护你的工作
自动保存、文档恢复和自动备份帮助保护你的进度。为 App 或私人文件夹设置密码。现有的 Notes Writer PDF 笔记和大纲都能在 Nautilus 中打开。

Watch Tuner Lite measures the accuracy of mechanical and automatic watches. It uses the built-in microphone or headset microphone to record the audible tick of the watch and calculates the seconds-per-day deviation. Works with almost any 'ticking' watch/clock.

Use in a quiet environment. Any ambient noise can affect the accuracy of the results. Complete silence is best.

Recommended way to record the ticks is to touch the crown of the watch with the headset microphone. You will get the best results using original Apple EarPods.

This is a simple version of Watch Tuner application. Not everyone needs detailed information about a watch movement, sometimes only accuracy is important. Watch Tuner Lite uses very similar algorithm like Watch Tuner does but displays only seconds-per-day deviation.

If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you.
If you prefer to measure also beat error and amplitude, try Watch Tuner - a bigger brother of this app.
If you need frequency diagram look at Watch Tuner Timegrapher - the most sophisticated app of Watch Tuner series.

Watch Tuner Lite measures the accuracy of mechanical and automatic watches. It uses the built-in microphone or headset microphone to record the audible tick of the watch and calculates the seconds-per-day deviation. Works with almost any 'ticking' watch/clock.

This is a simple version of Watch Tuner application. Not everyone needs detailed information about a watch movement, sometimes only accuracy is important. Watch Tuner Lite uses very similar algorithm like Watch Tuner does but displays only seconds-per-day deviation.

If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you.

學生、教師、作家、醫生、記者、學者和商務專業人士每天使用 Nautilus，記錄課堂筆記、會議筆記、標註的 PDF、已簽署的文件、論文和講座內容。

Notes Writer Pro 現已成為 Nautilus，以全新的 Notes Writer App 為基礎打造。它延續熟悉的寫作與 PDF 工具，並加入智慧型網頁瀏覽器、協助閱讀與研究的 AI，以及魔法套索。數學筆記本協助進行計算與建立圖表，讓你在 iPad 和 iPhone 上集中完成所有工作。

寫作，打造專屬內容
使用標題、清單、顏色與醒目標示建立筆記、論文和書籍。加入圖片，或用 Apple Pencil 記筆記。使用聽寫功能、回聽自己寫下的內容、查看詞數，並在分頁中保持文件開啟。使用 MS Word、RTF、Markdown 和純文字檔案。

閱讀並標註 PDF
閱讀電子書、文章和課堂教材，然後在頁邊書寫、標示重點、繪圖，並加入筆記、錄音或簽名。填寫並簽署表單、重新排列頁面，將紙本文件掃描成 PDF。並排比較兩份文件。依比例測量圖稿，並在分享前隱藏敏感文字。

瀏覽與研究
使用內建瀏覽器閱讀和研究，無需離開 Nautilus。在分頁中開啟頁面並將網站加入書籤。向 AI 詢問網頁內容，請 AI 總結或翻譯網頁，或將網頁內容轉成筆記。

使用魔法套索與 AI
用魔法套索圈選一段文字或其他內容，然後請 AI 解釋或總結所選內容。也可獲得寫作協助：改寫、簡化、修正拼字和文法、調整語氣，或透過對話整理想法。

記下想法，之後再找回
錄下講座、會議內容和想法。回聽錄音，或建立逐字稿，方便日後找回重要細節。在白板上連結筆記、圖片和錄音，用便箋收集隨手想法，並在大綱中整理計畫。在學習專案中彙整研究資料。使用分區和視覺化的軟木板規劃書籍或長篇論文。將來源放在草稿旁邊，修改時儲存快照，然後編譯成完整文件或電子書。

進行計算
使用數學筆記本將計算和說明放在一起。探索公式、建立圖表，並預覽完成後的 PDF。

整理與分享
將筆記保存在資料夾和筆記本中。為筆記本加上封面，方便辨識。掃描紙本文件、匯入 MS Word 文件和其他檔案，並透過搜尋找到所需內容。輸出為 PDF、Word、HTML、EPUB 等格式。與 iCloud、Dropbox、Box、Google Drive 或 WebDAV 同步。

守護你的工作
自動儲存、文件復原和自動備份協助保護工作進度。為 App 或私人資料夾設定密碼。現有的 Notes Writer PDF 筆記和大綱都能在 Nautilus 中開啟。

交回來的，是能直接用的成品。

不是一段建議，而是一份打開就能看的幻燈片、表格、圖表、文檔、設計稿或網站。你說出要做的事，剩下的交給它跑完。

【它能幫你做什麼】
文檔與辦公
・文檔處理——合同、報告、規格書丟進來，拆成能逐條對照的表
・幻燈片——把結論排成能直接上會的頁面，.pptx 下載即用
・電子表格——生成與整理 .xlsx，公式和格式都在

分析與研究
・數據分析及可視化——多份口徑不一的表格對齊、清洗、出圖
・深度研究——多輪檢索交叉核對，每個關鍵數字都帶得回原始出處
・調研（Wide Research）——多個對象、多個維度並排看

視覺與設計
・生成圖片——人物、場景、插畫、頭像，支援參考圖與多輪修改
・流程圖／架構圖——誰連著誰、什麼順序，交回一張打開就能看的圖
・設計——海報、封面、宣傳圖，交回可直接用的成品圖

開發與應用
・網站——雙擊就打開的頁面，手機上也能看
・應用——單個 .html 檔案，資料存在本機、可匯出備份
・遊戲——能玩得起來的一局，鍵盤與觸屏都能操作

教育與學習
・題目講解——考的是甚麼、易錯在哪一步，再附一道同類題

【會議轉寫與紀要】
・粵語、普通話、英語：錄音或上傳音頻，即時轉寫與翻譯
・自動整理成決議、行動項與待確認問題
・單次錄音最長 5 小時，音頻檔上傳最大 200MB

真正的工廠 - 充滿樂趣
您是大老闆，現在是時候負責您自己的桌面工廠了。組織工廠車間，管理您的工人，購買機械並設計高效的生產線 - 所有這些都在規定期限內完成，並讓您的客戶滿意！

Wreckfest 充滿了升級和自定義選項。無論您是準備使用加固保險槓、防滾架、側面保護裝置等進行下一次拆遷德比，還是使用空氣濾清器、凸輪軸、燃油系統等發動機性能部件為您的汽車進行一場激烈的比賽，Wreckfest 正在成為最好的競技賽車遊戲。

• 獨特的賽車體驗 –只有通過逼真的物理模擬才能實現。見證在高速賽道上瘋狂的並駕齊驅，在充滿交叉路口和迎面而來的車輛的瘋狂賽道上面臨徹底的破壞瘋狂，或者在德比賽場上大獲全勝。

• 有意義的定制 – 不僅可以改變汽車的外觀，還可以升級它們的防彈衣 – 用重鐵加固它們保護您免受損壞，但也會增加重量，這會影響汽車的操控性。修改您的汽車，以製造堅固的坦克或易碎但閃電般快速的火箭，或介於兩者之間的任何東西！

• 挑戰模式 - 與農作物收割機、割草機、校車、三輪車等等一起玩得開心！

• 職業生涯模式 – 爭奪冠軍，賺取經驗，解鎖新的升級和車輛，並成為歷史上的 Wreckfest 冠軍！

If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you.

Watch Tuner Lite measures the accuracy of mechanical and automatic watches. It uses the built-in microphone or headset microphone to record the audible tick of the watch and calculates the seconds-per-day deviation. Works with almost any 'ticking' watch/clock.

Use in a quiet environment. Any ambient noise can affect the accuracy of the results. Complete silence is best.

Recommended way to record the ticks is to touch the crown of the watch with the headset microphone. You will get the best results using original Apple EarPods.

This is a simple version of Watch Tuner application. Not everyone needs detailed information about a watch movement, sometimes only accuracy is important. Watch Tuner Lite uses very similar algorithm like Watch Tuner does but displays only seconds-per-day deviation.

If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you.
If you prefer to measure also beat error and amplitude, try Watch Tuner - a bigger brother of this app.
If you need frequency diagram look at Watch Tuner Timegrapher - the most sophisticated app of Watch Tuner series.

Use in a quiet environment. Any ambient noise can affect the accuracy of the results. Complete silence is best.

Recommended way to record the ticks is to touch the crown of the watch with the headset microphone. You will get the best results using original Apple EarPods.

This is a simple version of Watch Tuner application. Not everyone needs detailed information about a watch movement, sometimes only accuracy is important. Watch Tuner Lite uses very similar algorithm like Watch Tuner does but displays only seconds-per-day deviation.

If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you.
If you prefer to measure also beat error and amplitude, try Watch Tuner - a bigger brother of this app.
If you need frequency diagram look at Watch Tuner Timegrapher - the most sophisticated app of Watch Tuner series.

Watch Tuner Lite measures the accuracy of mechanical and automatic watches. It uses the built-in microphone or headset microphone to record the audible tick of the watch and calculates the seconds-per-day deviation. Works with almost any 'ticking' watch/clock.

Use in a quiet environment. Any ambient noise can affect the accuracy of the results. Complete silence is best.

Recommended way to record the ticks is to touch the crown of the watch with the headset microphone. You will get the best results using original Apple EarPods.

This is a simple version of Watch Tuner application. Not everyone needs detailed information about a watch movement, sometimes only accuracy is important. Watch Tuner Lite uses very similar algorithm like Watch Tuner does but displays only seconds-per-day deviation.

If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you.
If you prefer to measure also beat error and amplitude, try Watch Tuner - a bigger brother of this app.
If you need frequency diagram look at Watch Tuner Timegrapher - the most sophisticated app of Watch Tuner series.

ASES DA LUFTWAFFE - ESQUADRÃO é um jogo de tiros de rolagem vertical repleto de ação com uma narrativa fascinante e totalmente falada. Desvia-te de balas, recolhe power-ups massivos e usa sabiamente habilidades especiais para derrotares os teus inimigos. Duas campanhas com 50 níveis no total, ataques de vários inimigos mortais e muitas lutas épicas contra chefes. Estás preparado para a tarefa?

Quando a Europa parecia estar livre, um comando secreto alemão chamado Os Ases da Luftwaffe teve a oportunidade de se vingar e invadir os EUA! É teu dever restaurar a paz e a liberdade a bordo de asas mortais de aço em batalhas aéreas bombásticas! No entanto, qualquer história tem dois lados. Enquanto os Ases da Luftwaffe começam o seu ataque aos Estados Unidos, tu és encarregado de liderar um esquadrão de pilotos alemães de elite numa missão secreta. Entra numa aventura aérea épica de intrigas e rasteiras com uma base secreta no Triângulo das Bermudas. Escolhe o teu lado, decide o teu papel e descola!

- Jogo de tiros com efeitos especiais explosivos
- Asas NPC heroicos que seguirão as tuas ordens
- Árvores de habilidades com perícias individuais para cada asa

- 12 espetaculares lutas contra chefes
- Banda orquestral sonora épica, semelhante a um filme

pt.description:
Watch Tuner Lite measures the accuracy of mechanical and automatic watches. It uses the built-in microphone or headset microphone to record the audible tick of the watch and calculates the seconds-per-day deviation. Works with almost any 'ticking' watch/clock.

Use in a quiet environment. Any ambient noise can affect the accuracy of the results. Complete silence is best.

Recommended way to record the ticks is to touch the crown of the watch with the headset microphone. You will get the best results using original Apple EarPods.

This is a simple version of Watch Tuner application. Not everyone needs detailed information about a watch movement, sometimes only accuracy is important. Watch Tuner Lite uses very similar algorithm like Watch Tuner does but displays only seconds-per-day deviation.

If you want to know how much your watch is fast or slow, this application is for you.
If you prefer to measure also beat error and amplitude, try Watch Tuner - a bigger brother of this app.
If you need frequency diagram look at Watch Tuner Timegrapher - the most sophisticated app of Watch Tuner series.

pt.description:
Guardian OL2 é um MMORPG de ação 3D em estilo retrô onde um só herói vive em dois mundos. Aventure-se online com jogadores reais ou explore seu Mundo Solo privado no seu ritmo — seu personagem, equipamento e diamantes acompanham você em tudo.

DOIS MUNDOS, UM HERÓI
• Mundo Multiplayer — um reino online vivo: masmorras em equipe, comércio na casa de leilões, rankings
• Mundo Solo — uma cópia privada do continente no seu ritmo: sem filas, sem competição, só você e seus seguidores
• Uma só lista — troque quando quiser; progresso, itens e carteira compartilhados

CINCO CLASSES
• Templário — cavaleiro sagrado cujas curas e bênçãos mantêm o grupo vivo
• Mago — frágil, mas devastador mestre do fogo, gelo e arcano
• Bruxo — atirador veloz do clã do sangue: tiros precisos e flechas paralisantes
• Grande Espada Guerreira — baluarte de sangue titânico: provocações, muralhas de escudos e golpes esmagadores
• Berserker — anão devoto do fogo que ceifa as fileiras inimigas em fúria giratória

UM CONTINENTE A CONQUISTAR
Siga a história própria da sua classe por aldeias, tundras congeladas, cavernas de aranhas e criptas assombradas até Grand Village, a cidade-base onde a verdadeira caça começa. Missões, elites e drops do mundo em cada canto.

MASMORRAS E CHEFES
Enfrente a cova do lobo, o Ninho de aranha, o covil orc e o Cofre escuro. Cada chefe — o rei lobo sanguinário, o Dragão Vermelho, abrak a aranha, o Rei Esqueleto Leon, o Rei Demônio Naros — traz seu truque: invocações, congelamento, veneno, atordoamento.

TRÊS MODOS DE RISCO
• Normal — sem penalidade de morte; perfeito para aprender
• Pesadelo — morrer custa moedas e cristais; loot e XP melhores
• Inferno — penalidades brutais, os melhores drops e PvP em mundo aberto

OFÍCIOS E EQUIPAMENTO
Minere, colete ervas, pesque e cace — depois forje armas, cozinhe pratos com bônus, prepare poções e encante equipamento. Aprimore, encaixe gemas e desmonte o excedente. Pergaminhos de receitas caem no mundo. Conjuntos dão poder extra.

COMÉRCIO, SEGUIDORES E FACÇÕES
Venda seu loot para jogadores reais na casa de leilões. Contrate seguidores — morcegos, dríades, golems, cogumelos — para lutar ao seu lado. Ganhe reputação com cinco facções (Cavaleiros da luz, Legião Titã, Aliança oculta, Fogo de armas, A fonte da vida) e troque por equipamento exclusivo.

RECOMPENSAS DIÁRIAS
Presentes de login, ofertas diárias, baús diários, conquistas e rankings do servidor fazem cada sessão valer a pena.

AGORA EM 18 IDIOMAS
A mesma conta funciona em iOS e Android — o progresso nunca se perde. Jogo premium: pague uma vez, sem anúncios. Compras opcionais no app (diamantes, assinatura) disponíveis.

RadarScope is an AMS-award-winning weather visualization tool that empowers meteorologists, public safety officials, storm spotters, and weather enthusiasts to view a full suite of single-site radar data and related severe weather products. Your initial purchase provides professional radar visualization in a fully native app, free from distracting and invasive practices, with optional subscription packages to add even more capabilities.

Whether you’re scanning for a mesocyclone’s tell-tale hook echo, pinpointing the landfall of a hurricane’s eye wall, or identifying velocity couplet, hail spike, or debris ball signatures, RadarScope displays native radar data in its original radial format. You see what the radar sees almost as soon as the radar sees it, with automatic updates every two to ten minutes depending on the radar’s scanning strategy.

Your initial app purchase includes the following:

• Full suite of single-site radar products for the US, Canada, Guam, Denmark, Finland, and Germany
• 10-frame radar loops
• Two built-in providers for radar data
• Tornado, thunderstorm, flash flood, marine, snow squall, extreme wind, tropical, and other warnings in the US
• Selected severe weather warnings in Canada and Australia
• Severe weather watches in the US and Canada
• NWS-generated storm tracks with hail, TVS, and mesocyclone attributes
• Inspector and distance tools
• Color palette options for radar data
• Weather Pulse data plan integration
• Spotter Network integration for storm and location reporting
• mPING integration for submitting weather reports to NSSL
• Bundled maps with political borders, water bodies, and highways, optimized for low-bandwidth use
• Support for widgets and complications
• Universal app for Apple platforms, including Apple Watch, and Apple TV
• CarPlay support
• Family Sharing support

RadarScope Pro Tier One is an optional annual subscription that adds more features for tracking severe weather:

• 30-frame radar loops
• Cloud-to-ground lightning strikes
• Special weather statements in the US and Canada
• Mesoscale convective and precipitation discussions
• SPC convective, tornado, hail, wind, and fire outlooks
• WPC excessive rainfall outlooks in the US
• Local storm reports in the US
• Custom color palette support
• Multi-pane display (2 on phones; 4 on larger devices)
• Family Sharing support

RadarScope Pro Tier Two is an optional annual or monthly subscription that transforms RadarScope into a more complete visualization tool for a larger suite of weather products, including:

• Everything in Pro Tier One
• 50-frame radar loops
• A third provider for US radar data
• 30-year archive of NEXRAD Level II radar data
• 6-year archive of NEXRAD Level III data
• 30-day archive of super-res and non-US radar data
• 20-year archive of NWS bulletins
• GOES satellite data
• Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS) data
• Real-Time Mesoscale Assimilation (RTMA) data
• GFS, ECMWF, HRRR, HRW, NAM, and RRFS model data
• Surface observations
• ProbSevere layer
• Atmospheric soundings in the US
• Hail size, hail probability, and azimuthal shear contours with a 30-day archive
• More detailed transportation and satellite imagery maps
• Custom color palette support for GOES, MRMS, RTMA, and forecast products
• Server-sent events for radar and warning updates
• Cross-platform subscription sharing on up to 5 devices

Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal disabled via your App Store account settings after the purchase.
